summary: FAIL. The round-9 code change (rules.mjs:313, \S+ -> .+?) is correct and fails closed under 8 adversarial cases. Tests (53+5) pass, prefreeze passes in a fresh clone, and there are no secrets, personal data or CDNs. New finding F-DG0-134 (Medium, mandatory, REQ-DLV-007): the hook command picks the guard from the hook cwd's git toplevel. In the documented '--cwd <worktree>' concurrent-writer mode, any role can Write/Edit the main repository's protected files (gate rules, write scopes, .claude/, stages.json, gate records) with file tools alone. A live probe in this session also showed that a Bash cd into a nested repo swaps in that repo's guard-write.mjs.
